services.name: Private Charter on Schooner Adirondack III
services.desc: In addition to the public sails listed on this site, the Schooner Adirondack III is available for Private Charter! You and up to 41 other guests can have her all to yourselves for a private sailing excursion in the New York Harbor. She is quite popular for corporate outings, team-builders, birthdays, anniversaries, wedding parties, and family and alumni reunions. Full catering and bar options are available. quotes.author: Sunset Cruise Customer
quotes.text: The Luxury Yacht Sunset Cruise was nothing short of perfect. The staff is extremely friendly and courteous, and my date and I had a great time aboard the ship. The interior of the yacht is very comfortable with an enormous amount of class. It’s also impeccably kept. I would go again in a heartbeat!”– Sunset Cruise Customer
